Adam, Seth, Enosh,
Adam, Seth, Enosh;
亞當生塞特；塞特生以挪士；
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
以挪士生該南；該南生瑪勒列；瑪勒列生雅列；
Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech.
Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;
雅列生以諾；以諾生瑪土撒拉；瑪土撒拉生拉麥；
The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
拉麥生挪亞；挪亞生閃、含、雅弗。
The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.
雅弗的兒子是歌篾、瑪各、瑪代、雅完、土巴、米設、提拉。
The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Diphath and Togarmah.
歌篾的兒子是亞實基拿、低法（在創世記十章三節是利法）、陀迦瑪。
And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim and Rodanim.
雅完的兒子是以利沙、他施、基提、多單。
The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
The sons of Ham: Cush and Egypt, Put and Canaan.
含的兒子是古實、麥西、弗、迦南。
The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabta and Raama and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
古實的兒子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉瑪、撒弗提迦。拉瑪的兒子是示巴、底但。
Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
And Cush was the father of Nimrod: he was the first to be a great man in the earth.
古實生寧錄；他為世上英雄之首。
Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
And Egypt was the father of the Ludim and the Anamim and the Lehabim and the Naphtuhim
麥西生路低人、亞拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
And the Pathrusim and the Casluhim and the Caphtorim (from whom came the Philistines).
帕斯魯細人、迦斯路希人、迦斐託人；從迦斐託出來的有非利士人。
And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
And Canaan was the father of Zidon, his oldest son, and Heth,
迦南生長子西頓，又生赫
the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,
和耶布斯人、亞摩利人、革迦撒人、
the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,
希未人、亞基人、西尼人、
the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite.
亞瓦底人、洗瑪利人，並哈馬人。
The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram and Uz and Hul and Gether and Meshech.
閃的兒子是以攔、亞述、亞法撒、路德、亞蘭、烏斯、戶勒、基帖、米設（在創世記十章二十三節是瑪施）。
Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
And Arpachshad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
亞法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days a division was made of the earth; and his brother's name was Joktan.
希伯生了兩個兒子：一個名叫法勒（就是分的意思），因為那時人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫約坍。
And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah
約坍生亞摩答、沙列、哈薩瑪非、耶拉、
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah
哈多蘭、烏薩、德拉、
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
And Ebal and Abimael and Sheba
以巴錄、亞比瑪利、示巴、
Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
阿斐、哈腓拉、約巴。這都是約坍的兒子。
So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah,
Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
閃生亞法撒；亞法撒生沙拉；
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
沙拉生希伯；希伯生法勒；法勒生拉吳；
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
拉吳生西鹿；西鹿生拿鶴；拿鶴生他拉；
and Abram (that is, Abraham).
Abram (that is Abraham).
他拉生亞伯蘭，亞伯蘭就是亞伯拉罕。
The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
亞伯拉罕的兒子是以撒、以實瑪利。
These are their genealogies:
These are their generations: the oldest son of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam,
以實瑪利的兒子記在下面：以實瑪利的長子是尼拜約，其次是基達、押德別、米比衫、
Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad and Tema,
米施瑪、度瑪、瑪撒、哈達、提瑪、
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
伊突、拿非施、基底瑪。這都是以實瑪利的兒子。
The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's servant-wife: she was the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
亞伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的兒子，就是心蘭、約珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、書亞。約珊的兒子是示巴、底但。
The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.
And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
米甸的兒子是以法、以弗、哈諾、亞比大、以勒大。這都是基土拉的子孫。
Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
And Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒的兒子是以掃和以色列。
The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel and Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
以掃的兒子是以利法、流珥、耶烏施、雅蘭、可拉。
The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zephi and Gatam, Kenaz and Timna and Amalek.
以利法的兒子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基納斯、亭納、亞瑪力。
The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.
流珥的兒子是拿哈、謝拉、沙瑪、米撒。
The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
And the sons of Seir: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan.
西珥的兒子是羅坍、朔巴、祭便、亞拿、底順、以察、底珊。
The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan's sister.
羅坍的兒子是何利、荷幔；羅坍的妹子是亭納。
The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
The sons of Shobal: Alian and Manahath and Ebal, Shephi and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
朔巴的兒子是亞勒文、瑪拿轄、以巴錄、示非、阿南。祭便的兒子是亞雅、亞拿。
The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.
亞拿的兒子是底順。底順的兒子是哈默蘭、伊是班、益蘭、基蘭。
The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
The sons of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
以察的兒子是辟罕、撒番、亞干。底珊的兒子是烏斯、亞蘭。
These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
Now these are the kings who were ruling in the land of Edom, before there was any king over Israel: Bela, the son of Beor; his town was named Dinhabah.
以色列人未有君王治理之先，在以東地作王的記在下面：有比珥的兒子比拉，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
At his death, Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.
比拉死了，波斯拉人謝拉的兒子約巴接續他作王。
When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
At the death of Jobab, Husham, from the land of the Temanites, became king in his place.
約巴死了，提幔地的人戶珊接續他作王。
When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
And at the death of Husham, Hadad, the son of Bedad, who overcame Midian in the field of Moab, became king; his town was named Avith.
戶珊死了，比達的兒子哈達接續他作王。這哈達就是在摩押地殺敗米甸人的，他的京城名叫亞未得。
When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.
哈達死了，瑪士利加人桑拉接續他作王。
When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river became king in his place,
桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接續他作王。
When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, became king in his place.
掃羅死了，亞革波的兒子巴勒‧哈南接續他作王。
When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadad became king in his place; his town was named Pai, and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
巴勒‧哈南死了，哈達接續他作王。他的京城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希她別，是米‧薩合的孫女，瑪特列的女兒。
Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
And Hadad came to his end. Now the chiefs of Edom were: the chief of Timna, the chief of Aliah, the chief of Jetheth,
哈達死了，以東人的族長有亭納族長、亞勒瓦族長、耶帖族長、
Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
The chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon,
亞何利巴瑪族長、以拉族長、比嫩族長、
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
The chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar,
基納斯族長、提幔族長、米比薩族長、
Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
The chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
瑪基疊族長、以蘭族長。這都是以東人的族長。
